summary.text: Ciatta Thompson is the Republican candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 33, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Shannon Isadore (D).
Ballotpedia lists her profession as hospitality management, and in a Ballotpedia survey she said she lives in Northwest Portland and works at a downtown hotel.

paragraphs.text: Ciatta Thompson attended Hazelwood West High School.

In her Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born in New York to working-class parents, that her mother is from Monrovia, Liberia, and that her family moved often because of her mother's career in the travel industry.
She described herself as a former lifelong Democrat who left the party.
Thompson advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.

In her survey, she listed addiction and mental health treatment capacity, accountability for taxpayer dollars, local control over public safety and homelessness, and lower housing and child care costs among her priorities.
